reserveReview.rationale: M0's first-party Protocol API capture on 2026-07-15 reports 2.1% cash and 97.9% eligible token collateral after the live adapter's normalization; a 0.000115% non-eligible token residual remains below display precision. Its 2026-07-14 token time series identifies USTB as the sole eligible on-chain collateral definition. The Ethereum MToken contract and pinned source corroborate the live token and gateway context without treating token supply as a collateral total.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: M0 Protocol API CollateralCurrent capture normalized by the live m0 adapter and 2026-07-14 token time series
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The first-party current response discloses a 0.000115% non-eligible token-collateral residual but does not identify its token or obligor.
